cut-the-rope-holiday-gift.title: Cut The Rope Holiday Gift: Festive Puzzle Adventure
cut-the-rope-holiday-gift.slogan: Spread Holiday Cheer with Om Nom!
cut-the-rope-holiday-gift.description: Join Om Nom in Cut The Rope Holiday Gift, a festive puzzle adventure set in a winter wonderland. Help Om Nom collect candy canes by solving challenging puzzles and overcoming obstacles. Enjoy the holiday spirit with this special edition of the beloved Cut The Rope series. Play now and spread the joy!

HomeIframe.title: Cut The Rope Holiday Gift
HomeIframe.description: Experience the holiday magic with Cut The Rope Holiday Gift. Solve festive puzzles, collect stars, and help Om Nom enjoy his candy canes. Play now and join the fun!

HomeFeatures.whatIsTitle: What is Cut The Rope Holiday Gift?
HomeFeatures.whatIsDescription: Cut The Rope Holiday Gift is a festive puzzle game where you help Om Nom collect candy canes in a winter wonderland. Solve puzzles, overcome obstacles, and spread holiday cheer!
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep1: Cut the ropes to release the candy canes.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep2: Collect stars to complete each level.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep3: Feed Om Nom and enjoy the holiday fun!
HomeFeatures.feature1Description: Solve holiday-themed puzzles to help Om Nom collect candy canes.
HomeFeatures.feature2Description: Explore a beautiful snowy landscape filled with festive decorations.
HomeFeatures.feature3Description: Overcome obstacles like crumbling candy canes and tight ropes.
HomeFeatures.feature4Description: Gather stars to complete each level and achieve higher scores.
